packageRules.description: Backend: ruff + ~260 pytest tests, API routes exercised through FastAPI's TestClient (fastapi, starlette, pydantic, httpx). Enough to merge minor updates unattended. npm minor updates stay manual: the frontend is only checked by tsc + vite build, nothing renders the app (see issue #32).
